snippet.title: Akumajou Densetsu (FAMICOM) Gameplay 480p (悪魔城伝説) | No Commentary (Orig NES Hardware Composite)
snippet.description:
The Famicom version of Castlevania 3, with expanded audio!

NESGUIDE ARCHIVE INFO

The original NES gameplay archive, est Jan 2007. This channel contains a complete set of gameplay videos for the NTSC catalog of the Nintendo Entertainment System, commonly known as the NES. 

The goal of this archive and the sister archives is to produce reference-worthy gameplays for full console catalogs. Ideally, to serve as accurate representations of casual, non-competitive play; exhibiting basic mechanics and audio/visual design.





This is an independent project, not affiliated with Nintendo or any other game company. Original copyright information for this game is usually listed on the title screen.
